feature: Mobile-number OTP sign-in
notes: IronDost: Firebase phone OTP plus Google sign-in.

feature: Area check with a clear 'not served' state
notes: IronDost checks at the address step (S07). Reviews say DhobiLite and Tumbledry only decide after booking.

feature: Public price list on the website
notes: Fabrico lists 213 garments per store with an update date (agent-observed). Tumbledry offers a download only. IronDost web has no price page though GET /v1/catalog is public.

feature: Saved addresses with map pin or GPS
notes: All five. IronDost: map pin, place search, saved addresses.

feature: Itemised catalogue with prices before you confirm
notes: DhobiLite, Tumbledry and Fabrico flows show no item price at booking (reviews allege bill shock). IronDost shows prices and a server quote. A differentiator.

feature: Running total from a server quote before paying
notes: LaundryMate basket total and LaundroKart order bill seen in screenshots.

feature: Audience filters in the catalogue (Men, Women, Kids, Household)
notes: IronDost catalogue is by service category only.

feature: Item search
notes: IronDost S13.

feature: Per-kg pricing option for everyday wash
notes: IronDost schema has a KG unit; weighing and repricing happen in the admin after pickup.

feature: Care options and add-ons (starch, hanger pack, softener, packing choice)
notes: None in IronDost.

feature: Range beyond everyday clothes (shoes, bags, carpets, curtains, sofa)
notes: Outside the ironing-first launch scope; IronDost has Dry Cleaning but not these.

feature: Pickup date strip with time windows
notes: All five. IronDost: Morning 7-11, Noon 11-16, Evening 16-20.

feature: Pickup windows of 2.5 hours or less
notes: DhobiLite 2 h, Tumbledry and Fabrico 1 h, LaundryMate 2.5 h. IronDost windows are 4 to 5 h. LaundroKart about 3 to 4 h.

feature: Customer picks the delivery window separately
notes: IronDost chooses pickup and delivery together.

feature: Express or faster-turnaround option with the extra charge shown
notes: All five, with surcharges from +20% to +100%. Tumbledry states both 1.5x and 2x on different pages. IronDost has a fixed 20 h minimum turnaround and no option.

feature: Ultra-fast local mode (15-minute pickup, 4-hour delivery)
notes: LaundryMate Sprint, one Bengaluru area only.

feature: Reschedule a pickup in the app
notes: IronDost help text says cancel and book again.

feature: Cancel an order in the app
notes: IronDost allows cancel until pickup.

feature: Minimum order rule shown before confirming
notes: DhobiLite 299 + tax, Tumbledry 350, Fabrico 349.

feature: Free pickup and delivery above a threshold
notes: IronDost has a free-delivery limit setting.

feature: Promo codes at checkout
notes: IronDost promo sheet.

feature: First-order discount applied automatically
notes: Coupon engine exists; first-order eligibility and a free-garments benefit are not implemented (IMPLEMENTATION.md).

feature: Prepaid wallet or credit with bonus
notes: All five: plans, packages, wallet credit. Package terms differ between surfaces at Tumbledry and DhobiLite (OBSERVED).

feature: Membership with guaranteed slots or free delivery
notes: Needs a wallet and recurring pickups first.

feature: Referral programme
notes: Fabrico Refer and Earn tab; DhobiLite referral coupon.

feature: Recurring scheduled pickups
notes: LaundryMate ClubUltimate auto-creates orders.

feature: Online payment (UPI, cards, netbanking)
notes: IronDost: Razorpay.

feature: Cash on delivery
notes: IronDost: staff record cash at delivery.

feature: Bill or invoice viewable in the app
notes: Tumbledry reviewers say they cannot see an invoice in the app.

feature: Pay a balance due on an existing order
notes: IronDost S43.

feature: Stage-by-stage order timeline
notes: Tumbledry shows four counters only; Fabrico shows a pickups and drop-offs list.

feature: Push or SMS update at each stage
notes: IronDost: push plus in-app inbox; no SMS.

feature: Partner name and call button on the order
notes: IronDost shows the partner once assigned.

feature: Share live location with the rider
notes: DhobiLite only.

feature: Book again from a finished order
notes: IronDost 'Book again'.

feature: Quick order: schedule now, count items at pickup
notes: Four apps work this way. Pair it with customer approval of the final price.

feature: In-app support with call, form and photo
notes: IronDost has Help and a support call; no ticket form or photo.

feature: WhatsApp channel in the app or one tap away
notes: IronDost marketing plans use WhatsApp as a fallback; the app has none.

feature: Order-linked problem report with a visible status
notes: Top complaint theme (unanswered support, 18% of sampled reviews). Not seen working in any app.

feature: Damage or loss policy with a stated remedy
notes: IronDost has an FAQ answer only, no claim record.

feature: Free reprocessing if unhappy
notes: DhobiLite 7-day, LaundryMate 'no questions asked'.

feature: Garment tagging or photos at pickup
notes: Needs the partner flow, which does not exist yet.

feature: Process steps shown to the customer
notes: Marketing storytelling more than function.

feature: Rating or feedback prompt after delivery
notes: Not seen in any of the five. A chance to be first.

feature: Language switch (Hindi or Telugu)
notes: Only Fabrico, and only a switch whose options were not seen. IronDost is English only.

feature: Dark mode
notes: DhobiLite dark only; IronDost light and dark.

feature: Contrast and text scaling that meet WCAG AA
notes: Fabrico (2.2:1), DhobiLite (blue button 3.7:1), LaundryMate (3.3:1) and LaundroKart (3.4:1) each fail at least one pair I measured. Tumbledry passed the four I could measure, but its agent estimates white on amber near 1.6:1 from eyeballed colours. IronDost passes 26 of 26 pairs.

feature: Delete account inside the app
notes: IronDost S46 and S47.

feature: In-app notification inbox
notes: IronDost S25.

feature: Offers list with codes
notes: IronDost Offers tab.

feature: Local landing pages per neighbourhood
notes: IronDost web has home, support and policy pages only.

feature: Store locator or walk-in drop-off
notes: IronDost is doorstep-only with no retail stores.

feature: Franchise programme
notes: Not a customer feature.

feature: Business or bulk accounts
notes: product-marketing lists B2B as later.

feature: Price-change notice with refund-due alert
notes: IronDost only: staff reprice, customer told, refund alert raised.

feature: Honest overdue label instead of a made-up ETA
notes: IronDost only (IMPLEMENTATION.md).
